text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: ...We lost, didn't we, Accu-san?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Truly. They were shining ever so 
brightly.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: ...As for today's champion...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: âDid you see that? Mom... Dad...
choice_data_list:
You were there to see them both through to 
the end, right?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ! ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: How did it look to you?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: This Espoir City.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Hahaha!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations on 1st place, Espoir 
City-san!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Following up on last year, taking on the 
rotation from the Mile CS Nambu Hai to the 
Champions Cup! And coming away with a 
brilliant victory, no less—

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
In short, what do you think was the 
deciding factor in your victory!?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Huh~? Key to victory...?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"I prepared for the Champions Cup last 
time too. I think... I was being 
especially careful with my very first 
step."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Didn't you catch the flow pretty well 
after that? You timed your acceleration 
during the mid-leg nicely, too.

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
O-Ohh...! That's an amazing 
self-analysis...!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Whoa?! Don't butt in so suddenly!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, fufufu...! You two get along so 
well. ...Then, for such a Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
What kind of Umamusume is Espoir City-san 
to you?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...What kind of Umamusume was she?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At first, I thought she was an Umamusume 
who couldn't focus. Then I realized she 
was just trying too hard to act tough.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to give her confidence, so I made 
up the lie about being the 'strongest 
Umamusume.' ...Though that lie eventually 
got exposed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Every day spent with her was a learning 
experience.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The joy of teaching, and the hardships of 
it, too. As well as the delight of 
standing beside her as she grows.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —She taught me everything.
choice_data_list: Espo is— truly a strong Uma Musume.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
choice_data_list:
She's an Umamusume strong enough to fight 
even without me.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Fools.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Without you, the Espoir City standing here 
wouldn't exist.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: I'm only here because of you.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Don't you ever forget, Trainer. Just who 
it was that you raised.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Remember this—remember me winning today. 
Don't ever forget the joy of this day.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
—'Cause everything is right here inside me 
'n you.
